credits.musicAiNote: Fitting copyright-free songs in a late-90s and 2000s style that may be shared in a mod are very hard to find. So some tracks (with "AI" in their name) are placeholders made with AI (ACE-Step). They show how the music is meant to feel in each situation and will be replaced by real tracks as soon as there are some. In the pause menu under Esc > Mods > Hashiriya Battle you choose for every situation which songs play, and you can add your own music. Everyone is free to use these tracks.

title.betaText: Hashiriya Battle is being balanced with your help. Is a rival, a part, a price or a job too strong, too weak or simply off? Tell us in the "Hashiriya Battle" thread on the BeamNG forum. For bugs, a bug report from the Hashiriya menu helps.
new.balanceNote: Prices, rival strength and rewards will be tuned over time based on community feedback, so a save may feel a little different after an update. Thanks for playing and helping to test!
title.musicText: For the best experience, play with your own music. Put songs (OGG, WAV, MP3) into the hashiriya_musik folder in your BeamNG user folder, sorted by situation: day, night, battle, shop and more. In the pause menu under Esc > Mods > Hashiriya Battle you choose for every song where it plays.
new.musicNote: Tip: your own music makes it complete. Put your songs into the hashiriya_musik folder in the BeamNG user folder and set where they play in the pause menu under Esc > Mods > Hashiriya Battle.

save.gag.title: ENGINE OFF!
save.gag.1: It's 2026. The planet doesn't idle, so neither should you.
save.gag.2: Per Idling Regulation C1/2026 you may only save with the engine off. That regulation doesn't exist. It still applies.
save.gag.3: Your engine is burning fuel to do absolutely nothing. Even the polar bears think that's a bit much.
save.gag.4: Carbon footprint of this save file: catastrophic. Turn the key, then try again.
save.gag.5: The save file is on strike while your exhaust is smoking. It's about to glue itself to the guardrail.
save.gag.6: The trees at the parking area started a petition: engine off first, then save.
save.gag.7: Idling while parked? In 2026? Your car is about to get a strongly worded letter from the ozone layer.
save.gag.8: A hashiriya with style shuts the engine off. Saves fuel, spares the turbo and rescues a few penguins on the side.
save.gag.repeat: Again? The engine is STILL running. Somewhere, an emissions sticker is quietly crying.
save.gag.hint: Switch the ignition off, then save again.

save.towed.short: That was all the money you had. They generously let the rest slide.
save.towed.hint: Tip: stop, engine off, then “Park & save here” in the menu. You will continue right there.

new.modeHardcoreD: For those who want to find out. Fixed for this save and cannot be switched later.
new.modeHardcoreRules:
Engine starts cold, warm it up first.
Maintenance is due twice as fast, running out of oil or coolant destroys the engine.
Starter car with an almost empty tank, fuel use one and a half times.
Everything costs one and a half times as much, prize money only three quarters.
Pink slip rivals only race for cars.
More mobile police checks by day, more traffic.
Save only at home or in the garage, quitting mid-battle counts as a loss.
Rivals not on minimap and radar, no fast travel to PAs.
Game over deletes the save.
